name: update_summary
description: Update a Ticket only for an explicitly identified same-incident follow-up; never append a newly reported failure.

ticketId.description: The ticket readable ID or database serial ID

runningSummary.description: Compatibility context only. The backend preserves the stored history and never replaces it with this value.

lastAiSummary.description: Only the newest customer-provided detail from this follow-up. The backend appends it as one history bullet and ignores duplicate retries.

planeSynced.description: True when the linked Plane work item was updated

planeIssueId.description: Linked Plane work item ID when synchronized

reasoningHints: Use only when the customer explicitly identifies the same existing Ticket. Different error codes, systems/modules, primary symptoms, or impacts without an explicit same-Ticket reference require create_ticket.

Claim an update only when this tool returns success=true. If the explicitly referenced Ticket is missing, deleted, or terminal, never create a replacement Ticket as fallback; report that it could not be updated and follow the tool-failure handoff policy.
A linked Plane work item is updated after the TicketX summary is saved; inspect planeSynced in the result.
